interpretation_boundary: This stage prepares train-only structures and reads no docking score, fresh-validation row, or test row. Preparation success does not establish enrichment, QUBO portability, QUBO superiority, or quantum advantage.
next_gate: generate and independently audit the 16-receptor by Train-668 by three-seed Uni-Dock matrix

preparation.macrocycle_policy: Run Meeko flexible first. If preparation fails or closure pseudoatoms are detected, rerun once with --rigid_macrocycles; require zero closure pseudoatoms in the final PDBQT.
preparation.rdkit_method: ETKDGv3 with explicit hydrogens, useRandomCoords=true, then MMFF94 or UFF with 500 iterations
